notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow Warriors!

After a day of fixing issues, we have released a little update for our demo.
The following stuff is out now: 

 Fixed an issue where Trinket slots where not properly displayed in 4-player multiplayer
 Fixed an issue when a player disconnects during a level up screen
 Fixed disconnect icons being displayed on all player portraits in the multiplayer lobby
 Fixed a sound issue with an enemy in Red Canyon
 Fixed an issue in multiplayer where progress was not properly tracked for the quests that unlock Secret Tincture, Prism & Persistence Rune for clients


We hope you enjoy the battle!

Your Warriors Team

notes.title: Major Demo Update!
notes.content:
🚀 Royal Revolt Warriors - Major Demo Update: Online Multiplayer & 4-Player Co-op! 🎉  

Warriors, the time has come! The latest update for the Royal Revolt Warriors demo is here, and it’s our biggest one yet! ⚔️🔥 

🏆 Main Patch Notes:

🔹 Multiplayer Madness!
- We’ve enabled experimental 2-4 player online multiplayer via Steam Netplay!  
- Play with friends locally, online, or even mix and match both!  

🔹 Brand New Warrior!
- Added "Moe the Monk" incl. his ability and weapon enchantment.

🔹 New Warrior Abilities!
- Christa: "Berserk" – Unleash a furious attack speed boost!  
- Umberto: "Decoy" – Lure enemies in with a deadly trap that explodes based on their max HP.  
- Moe: "Cheers!" – Sacrifice HP to buff your and your allies’ damage!  
- Sam: "Satyrical Symphony" – A soothing melody that heals all nearby allies.  

🔹 New Weapons & Enchantments!
- "Tempest Rod" plus its "Storm Bringer" enchantment. 🌩️  
- "Valkyrie Spear" (Enchantment coming soon!).  
- "Gobbotech Mines" (Explosions incoming!).  
- Gaia Harp Enchantment: "Autumn Storm" – Nature’s fury unleashed.   
- Royal Brew Enchantment: "Volatile Brew" – Who knew a drink could be this explosive? 💥  

🔹 New Trinkets & Improvements!
- Gilded Purse: – More gold = more upgrades! 💰  
- All Warriors now have unique names (except the King… he’s still just "The King" 👑).  
- Reworked quests for better game flow.  
- Rebalanced Blacksmith upgrades & added new ones.  
- Kunais deal extra damage on impact before applying poison. 🗡️☠️  
- Monk’s Brew now has a hit sound (because audio cues matter!).  
- Tweaked VFX and fixed tons of bugs. 🛠️

⚡ Some known issues...
- When playing with 4 players, the UI displays 4 trinket slots for each player, even though only 3 can be filled.
- When playing online, the quests to unlock Secret Tincture, Prism & Persistence Rune only track progress for the host.

As we're adding so much content, features and the new mutliplayer functionality, unfortunatwely we have to wipe all existing savegames of the demo.

🎮 Please help us out and and test our new online co-op now! Your feedback will help us bugfix and fine-tune multiplayer for the full release. Join the Royal Revolt Warriors community, team up with friends, and conquer the madness together! 💪⚔️  

Thank you for your patience while we are working hard to get the release version of the game done as soon as possible!

👉 Join our Discord to share feedback and find teammates!

notes.title: Unmatched Powers: Meet the Blacksmith and their wonders
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/d5961e093f0e65a48a6e8251362fdef64b118197.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/7998e8e5b5bfc1d027ba56f99b4d1252e44fae6a.jpg

In a familiar land in dire danger, your allies aren't many, but they are crucial.

Among them stands the Mysterious Blacksmith, a shadowy figure cloaked in secrecy, their face forever hidden behind a haunting donkey mask. Whispers speak of their origins in the far reaches of A Trader's Tale, where deals were struck in shadows and fortunes forged in fire. Now, they emerge from obscurity, not as a hero, but as an essential ally in the battle to save the Realms.

For those bold enough to seek their aid—and pay the right price—they offer more than mere tools of war. They forge game-changing upgrades, weapons imbued with strength, and armor that turns the tide of fate itself. With their craft, the once impossible becomes achievable, allowing you to stand where others have fallen, to triumph where even you tasted defeat before.

If the future seems dark to day, one thing is certain: in this war, the right blade or unbreakable shield could mean the difference between victory and ruin. Seek them out, and let the fire of their forge light the path to your destiny.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/e8bc5403b2589a1292adf2f6b55cd7e19790aa95.png

In the heat of battle, every decision shapes your journey, Warrior.

Early on, when resources are limited and challenges are mounting, it’s smart to focus on essential upgrades like Health, Damage, and Attack Speed. These will give you the tools you need to survive the initial stages. As your wealth increases, it’s time to think strategically. If you prefer a specific weapon style—whether ranged or melee—consider enhancing the number of attacks it can deliver. Alternatively, investing in Critical Hit Chance and Damage can help you land harder-hitting strikes right from the start.

As you progress, the Blacksmith becomes even more valuable. They offer powerful tools to refine your loadout, including Rerolls to customize your upgrades, Additional Weapon Slots to diversify your arsenal, and Tomes for early, game-changing enchantments. These features let you adapt and strengthen your strategy, ensuring you’re always ready to face what lies ahead.

Every Warrior has their own path to victory, and with the Blacksmith’s expertise, you’ll have the upgrades you need to turn the tide in your favor. Use their skills wisely, and no challenge will be insurmountable!

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdTdpcnh0Nnh6aWVnMGM5cTFlOXlxbGJlbm9oanVnaWF6cTkzeTZiYSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/JZcUkAAXcUQBVN5ZKR/giphy.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/68c0b883bdde9649d07b281d6c97f6a7c73c2b4b.png

Several Key Features of the game can only be unlocked at the Blacksmith as the game progresses, such as:


 Rerolls
 More Weapon Slots
 Additional Tomes used for Weapon Enchantments


Every upgrade increases the cost of all others

All upgrades have a cap

Upgrades can be refunded free of charge either one by one or all together

 It is advisable to make full use of the Refund depending on your current needs


Not every Upgrade is available from the beginning, some take certain conditions to unlock

 Check the Quests Menu for unlock conditions


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/e4c21f232e902a5e13d55fb9b3d86a1ad9e2dbc1.png

When designing the Blacksmith feature for Royal Revolt Warriors it was important to us to provide players with a slow and steady progression of strength. No one single run, no matter if a map would be completed or not, should feel redundant to our players, since the Gold they earn can always be spent on something useful, that at the same time makes future runs less difficult. This is intended to create a sense of increasing power and battle versatility. So even if a Map proves to be too difficult at first, it can be overcome by tenacity and the help of the Blacksmith.

One challenging aspect of the feature for us as developers, is making sure there is also a steady progression of Gold costs in relation to power level, and at the same time making sure the upgrades are balanced with each other. This requires constant attention since the values need to be revised whenever a new upgrade is implemented.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/6aefde975c358e792c556a494edc9c2616a8a553.png

Creating the character of the mysterious Blacksmith was a very interesting endeavor. 
The design was first introduced in Royal Revolt: A Trader’s Tale, when the King himself initiated a cooperation between the protagonists and the smith, and has been undergoing several striking changes in its early development.

In the end, we settled for the current look, sporting a Donkey mask. This not only serves as a reference to a popular character from Royal Revolt 2 but is also a nod to the god of craftsmen, metalworking and blacksmiths Hephaestus from Greek mythology, whose sacred animal was a Donkey.

The design itself is shrouded in mystery, never speaking a single word, the face hidden behind a strange mask. The Blacksmith’s true identity has yet to be revealed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/6b625704eb2b49114659c05333b140421ad9c296.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/22e9abc9d9ff580d1f5a17b9127a908861e7d2ea.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/4ca2494ee0a5429040ef37ee681bd90e083cc024.jpg

notes.title: The Finest of the Realms - Meet Mina, the Royal Advisor
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/9420ef7e597d7772a49c0fef476e8af767f00578.png

- Always loyal Know-it-All -

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/5f0b7edcbe0caa742ed53bb232b41401b420c1b0.jpg

When the King needs a brain as sharp as a blade, Mina steps up—Advisor, battle strategist, and ultimate problem-solver. Known for her razor-sharp wit and unbreakable loyalty, Mina is the Queen of Comebacks both on and off the battlefield. Now, with her trusty Boomerang, she’s more than just a voice of wisdom—she’s a whirlwind of precision, bringing both brilliance and bruises to every fight. She jokes that her backpack’s like a black hole for everyone’s gear, and her two older brothers, Arthur and Jonathan, would agree—she’s always had the brains of the family.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/bb7f8ca9bcd50ed89911c62dfaf8b2be1918257d.png

Backpack

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/d4182caddc1bec4bc4efecdd401b2c97cffe078d.png

Years of joining the King on the battlefield have made Mina a powerful, resourceful and clever companion. What she lacks in physical strength she more than makes up for with her ability to carry Items around in her beloved Backpack:


 The Backpack automatically stores Pickups, allowing Mina to use them at any time or drop them for allies.
 Tapping the button uses the item in the backpack, holding down the button throws it forward so your friends can pick it up
 As the ability levels up, it can store more types of pickups, beyond just health regeneration items.
 At Level 2, Powerups can be added to the Backpack as well.


https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExeWl3MjN1Y3pudjgxdG5kZ3gwY3JlbGR2ZTR3dG9zdDRpaG4wOWlnNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/RDDbqQRe9tfeUnE0s1/giphy.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/10b26cd6038f3b4eb038209a917f03e7cb2ea8fb.png

Boomerang

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/a2a77f9a1dddc0491723cdb229093ef3ab8f2e81.png

Carrying around a regular Sword in her younger years, Mina has since found the true benefits of wielding a ranged Weapon.


 The Boomerang targets the nearest enemy in a straight line, dealing damage on its way out and back.
 Each additional projectile targets random enemies within range.
 Leveling up increases projectile count, attack speed, duration, and damage. At max level, the Boomerang will fly past the Advisor on its return, allowing it to hit enemies behind her as well.


https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYW5tdnd2MHdoZGtmeXlzMXdyd3c5MnhpM2htMnprdmVza2I3eHNwNSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/DziBCqgTi6jtCHvxUI/giphy.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/5b41f221e3edadbdf8843ccf6c288ab99d7b8d57.png

Weapon Enchantments aimed at the Boomerang, naturally make Mina’s weapon of choice even more powerful, making it a goal worth working towards.

Spiral Boomerang: Changes the attack pattern to spiral around the Advisor, covering a full 360° radius.

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZm9vbGo1dXRtdDY4MThoN3hnd2g4ODNsdGRicWRpNGJwY283OHR6ZSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/H0gOaAmmvcL7sihV0r/giphy.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/41e8532307dd1ed76639832468771d40e4cb88e9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/54cd77f1cce1177b3bf234ec2db26674a30bb1d1.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/e8bc5403b2589a1292adf2f6b55cd7e19790aa95.png

Mina has relatively low health, but her powerful Boomerang weapon more than compensates for it. Like the King, it’s crucial to prioritize upgrading the main Weapon early to unlock its level 8 ability. This removes downtime between attacks, allowing the Advisor to dominate the battlefield from the center while maintaining an upper hand.

Incorporating Gaia Harp or Monk’s Brew early on, if available, helps smooth out the randomness of the Boomerang’s attack pattern, giving you more control over the fight. The Boomerang even collects EXP Crystals automatically, reducing the need for constant movement. However, hunting down barrels, vases or crates for valuable pickups to store in the Backpack is vital. Keeping Ham handy to heal or a Bomb to clear enemy waves can be game-changers in tight situations.

As enemies grow tougher, essential trinkets like Prism, Royal Amulet, and Pocket Watch will bolster your offensive capabilities. Prism increases projectile count, benefiting both the Boomerang and Gaia Harp, while Royal Amulet enhances weapon damage. Pocket Watch extends the Boomerang's flight and Gaia Harp’s active time, helping you sustain damage output. If you find O.L.U.M., the increased projectile size will let you hit even more enemies with each attack, boosting your endgame effectiveness.

Endgame Build

Don’t forget to pick up the Golden Compass, which enables the Boomerang’s Enchantment. With the Spiral Boomerang, you’ll shred through enemies in every direction, even overwhelming bosses with ease. Once fully equipped, the Advisor will turn the battlefield into a breeze.

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExb3o2MGIzYTgyenlkNTB2bG42dTBuNWpibHQ3emltamNwdW4zYnJrMyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/aqhwIN4noukwoECvOW/giphy-downsized-large.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/9cc98d3f32749845fa519038fedfbff10a97d602.png

In co-op, the Advisor pairs well with a tanky ally like Christa. Christa can take hits and slow down enemies, giving the Advisor the time needed to clear out threats with her Boomerang and abilities. Together, they create a balanced team where Christa holds the line and the Advisor dishes out relentless damage from a safe distance.

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdHVlaGIwb3FjYjZtMzlldXBvYWJudzJvbDQycDA5eWRjdjFzZ2ptNiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/4RitGpEcYFsMK5W66Y/giphy-downsized-large.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/6aefde975c358e792c556a494edc9c2616a8a553.png

While not quite as old as the King’s, Mina’s original design is still up there amongst the historic legacy characters that helped shape Royal Revolt since its early beginnings. Although she didn’t show up until the sequel in 2013, she has since undoubtedly become the most recognizable face of the franchise, next to the King. She underwent many different outfit and hairdo iterations, before we settled for the now iconic look. Because of the importance of this design, we absolutely wanted to nail her transition from the girl of the past to the young woman she became in Royal Revolt Warriors. A challenge was to maintain her recognizability, while also showing a more mature personality, as she shed her more bratty spitfire-traits of previous installments to become a more focussed and keen character. Furthermore, since Mina was noticeably absent from Royal Revolt: A Trader's Tale, her new grown up version not only had to stay true to her legacy design, but also fit in seamlessly with the cast members that already received the "aging" treatment.

When thinking about her new Weapon (to avoid the repetition of the Sword she used to wield), the Boomerang occurred to us a natural fit, highlighting her nimble fighting style and resourceful wit. Mina is as loyal as they come and her lifelong friendship with the King is something we definitely wanted to translate in her design’s latest rendition.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/353cb659e196e31ffaf26894d12437a05050e1e8.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/9bdd61262b6f79d10a6faf1b44d78db92e585a03.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/1fe4f92fa087a27a1027eb950179d21fb9f0fe75.jpg

notes.title: Know your enemy - The Goblin Gang
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/b780bdf73d83b911eb2e5d9bf56c66ff63328a12.png

Deep within the Royal Forest lie the Goblin Tribes, living in chaotic harmony with Ogres, Trolls, and wild wolves. For decades, these wild tribes terrorized the nearby villages, launching raids and stealing anything they could get their hands on. Their brutal leader, the giant Ogre Freirke, was feared across the region.

However, peace was restored when the King and his trusted allies mounted a bold campaign, pushing the tribes back into the depths of the forest. Even Freirke himself fled, and for years, the villagers enjoyed a period of quiet. No goblins dared to venture out of the woods to cause trouble.

But recently, that peace has been shattered. Something strange has stirred the Goblins. They’ve grown wilder, driven to madness, and have begun pouring out of the forest once more. With renewed aggression, they are not only stealing but also attacking travelers and threatening the villages with a ferocity unseen before. What—or who—has provoked the Goblins into this frenzy remains a mystery, but the danger to the kingdom is all too real.

The King ordered a few troops to contain the danger from the Goblin tribes, but they never returned. Now, the King is taking the matter into his own hands and is gathering the best Warriors of the Realms. It is a dangerous and vital mission—perhaps the most important mission in the history of the kingdom.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/e8bc5403b2589a1292adf2f6b55cd7e19790aa95.png

Goblins & their older siblings

A single Goblin might not seem like a threat, but when they come in numbers, it’s a different story. If you’re not prepared, they can overwhelm and kill you faster than anything else. It’s simple: either you feed on them, or they feed on you.

To avoid becoming their next meal, it’s crucial to expand your attack area as quickly as possible. This can be done by acquiring more Weapons, increasing the AoE of your current ones, or relying on the ever-reliable Monk’s Brew—the ultimate Goblin counter. But beware!

Goblins can evolve if they survive long enough. Some will transform into massive, mountain-lifting Orcs or Trolls, while others grow even larger, losing their wits in the process. Then there are the clever ones, who use wooden pipes to spit foul projectiles at you from a distance. Some say there are even more mutations lurking in the depths of the woods. However, no matter which variant you face, you’ll need to boost your DPS to outmatch their strength and cunning. Equip yourself with powerful Trinkets like Dragon Fangs for increased attack speed and Royal Amulet for boosted damage output.

Once you’ve crushed their ranks, be ready for the real challenge—their Chieftain. This formidable foe wields a repurposed Castle Defense Arrow Tower as a club, and whatever he smashes won’t get back up. Before facing him, make sure to visit the Vendor and enchant your Weapon of choice—you’ll need every advantage to survive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/6aefde975c358e792c556a494edc9c2616a8a553.png

Oh, the pesky little pests they are - the Goblin Gang. Designing this ensemble of insurgents, we really wanted to provide a healthy roundup of the perhaps most well-known fantasy lore staples: Goblins, Trolls, Orcs and Ogres and have them all be united in one menacing gang wreaking havoc throughout the lands. Goblins and their congeners are a grand classique of medieval fantasy and pop culture, and there are countless varieties, some made extremely famous by TV shows or movies, others belonging to local folklore. The challenge was to add a unique twist to our version, which is why we decided to add some Royal Revolt-esque humor to this green horde of primitives. So when it comes to their attire and armory, we tried to highlight their limited ingenuity by having them misuse everyday items in a brute and make-shift way. Through the visual story-telling of this detail, one can only imagine how they obtained said items on one of their raids, but often ended up completely repurposing them. Old barrels as pauldrons, horseshoes as helmet accessories, roof shingles as loincloths, broken off defense towers as weapons, anything they could get their greedy paws on, highlighting their savage, yet dense ways. 

Now, all the power lies in your hands to defend the Royal Forest! Tell us in the comments: which horde would you like to challenge next?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/e21605bd8f94556bfe02b8d6f6ea755653ad8bbd.jpg

notes.title: Visit the Realms - The Royal Forest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/bbebe8c4e74f3934847e43470efaf7f9a81b011d.png

Some said that the Royal Forest was blessed by the gods. And even though conflicts had come throughout its history to disturb the serenity of the place, it was a dreamland for all: calm ponds, with soothing waters, sheltered by the benevolent canopies of the forest trees; singing rivers, like crystalline vessels of life; and rich lands, conducive to farming, where the King's herds grazed peacefully.
Sometimes, a few remnants of past wars could be spotted in this lush and vibrant landscape—some ruins of stone already overtaken by ivy, nature reclaiming its rights over a misstep. However, they existed for the inhabitants of the Kingdom as a memory, but also as a warning, a totem where each person silently vowed to defend this little piece of paradise with body and soul.

From the tall towers of the castle, the King watched over his people with the kindness of a man tested by years of rustic existence. He, who had worked so hard all his life to maintain the peace of the Kingdom, his beard and hair now graying, reassured himself by knowing that his subjects were unaware of all the energy and cunning deployed to preserve the sweetness of life in the Royal Forest. Yet sometimes, the King felt his heart gripped by a visceral, incomprehensible fear—the fear of falling asleep in the serenity of peace and waking up in the midst of a nightmare.

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExY2lkZm83d21xbmFkaW43eWdsanIydDFqdnR5cTNya3AwaWxheWhscCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/4zZSHVXWY2FodYKdLz/giphy-downsized-large.gif 

However, it had been a long time since goblins and other Lords had shown threatening behavior toward him. The Northern Kingdoms remained quiet, embroiled in their own conflicts and contradictions. The desert was silent, its creatures sleeping within. The steel of his sword itself no longer sang with the same intensity as in his younger years. So why did he not allow himself to embrace peace, the King wondered, leaning on one of the railings of his castle, his usually cheerful and merry gaze fixed on the roof of the Trader's little shop, which continued to thrive, equipping passing adventurers, hunters, and villagers with items forged by the strength of their arms. The King smiled. He had a deep friendship for these two young people, who worked hard to make their little shop shine, with a passion that reminded him of his own. With what they had gone through together, fighting goblins and other monsters, the King felt a sense of calm: he knew he could count on brave companions, no matter what fate had in store for him and his lands.

The King let out a light sigh and shook himself: no, really, what could happen that he should be wary of?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/23265f212d5042d44423932cfd792ba72219b6fd.png

Environment

Despite the Royal Kingdom and adjacent Royal Forest being the birthplace and home to the King, his Advisor and all the Kingdom’s other inhabitants for so many years, there’s still hidden corners to be discovered, no one seems to have ever laid eyes on. While quirky recluses like Guido manage to settle down in some of the more deserted glades and places, the Royal Forest still houses many secrets. Take those ominous Obelisks that suddenly showed up out of nowhere, for example. What mystery could they possibly be hiding?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/0d1cfa4c5ba1b92ea75b52ec444def192d05f38a.png

Enemies

On the brink of an event that is threatening to shake the realm's pillars of harmony to their very foundations, unknown forces are emerging to taint and destroy everything that is pure and innocent. What is it that our brave Warriors have to face and who is behind all this?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/9742fd403bdf6d86f44e8f85a7951184fcb21511.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/6aefde975c358e792c556a494edc9c2616a8a553.png

When designing the Royal Forest, two things were of special importance to us: 


 It should visually serve as a serene home to all the Royal Revolt protagonists we have grown to love over the years. A peaceful spot of nature with all the green and small rivers one could ever dream of - a place worth fighting for.

 At the same time, it should hold remnants of past conflicts, residue of war, reminding us of what once was. A place that is also clearly located close to the very kingdom players have been able to experience in previous franchise titles.


When the events of Royal Revolt Warriors kick off, we want it to be a place where we put ourselves on the line to protect. Not showing a single sign of what is about to happen.

Now please enjoy some of the Concept Art we created during the early development stages:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/538f9f5c0afe97a9fe7913b83c1fa6ab29f6213a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/d854f20c0c4ec37428822b852cf9b7e1c29e9dfa.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/6c4c8c77c403bd17f026ef3f395909581a7b170e.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/d714d6cd0779bda62828bc298506d005616a684b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/9fcdd82184a9e867af5e1bd0067c592f9be56ad4.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/ac7117832400e7c1b1aa676eae00aa4945064cad.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/14b0564779c4a5e23501d9626e65328d5f226e07.jpg

Have you ever walked down the villages of the Royal Forest and met the Trader? For how long have you known this peaceful place? Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: Feature Spotlight - Trinkets
notes.content:
In the Realms, conflict and war are as familiar as the dawn. His Majesty the King has faced them throughout his life, savoring the fleeting moments of peace that grace his lands. Until now, swords, axes, and bows, wielded by brave men and women, were sufficient to safeguard the Kingdom.

But that was before.

Now, a shadow looms—a threat unlike any they have faced. This is no time to linger on past grievances, for the very fabric of the Kingdom and all sovereigns across the planet hangs in the balance.
It is time... to rally! Assemble the mightiest Warriors from every Realm! Legends and heroes alike, united and ready to reclaim our peace! But raw strength alone will not suffice. A new power awaits: the Trinkets! Discover now how these ancient artifacts will elevate your might and dramatically enhance your chances of triumph over your foes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/ac3ad342fb4633ae34a75b06bfadf94ed4eb1a75.png

In Royal Revolt Warriors, Trinkets are magical gizmos that hold incredible potency. Each carrying its own unique power, your Warriors can use them to buff just about any aspect of their skills: Speed, Damage, Range, anything that can help you to become the ultimate Warriors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/5091a3a2bf5d16a5a8fe1360ffc2213eb5d4d90e.png

In combination with all the different Weapon types, they don’t just amplify combat efficiency, they open up sheer endless possibilities when it comes to designing your personal success formula. Your gameplay, your way: create the perfect combination, wait until you get your favorite Trinket available, and unleash your power, to become the danger.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/929dbd59b277c71058c0c2b06ed678b83d14a5da.png

Trinkets can either amplify a Warrior's strengths or compensate for their weaknesses. Understanding which trinket complements each hero is crucial for success. 

For example, Sam's Gaia Harp summons leaves that circle around him, covering all blind spots, but once it goes on cooldown, he’s left vulnerable. By equipping Dragon Fangs (which increase Attack Speed) and the Pocket Watch (which extends Attack Duration), you effectively eliminate the cooldown. The next attack begins before the previous one ends, briefly doubling his projectile count and keeping him constantly protected.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/f026be64d9006e2d7ab262a91ae4f84906e34acb.gif

Christa, on the other hand, has high health and great damage potential, plus the ability to stun enemies, but her main weakness is her slow speed. While it might seem logical to give her Shadow Boots to improve mobility, sometimes it's better to play to her strengths. Equipping her with Verdant Blessing for health regeneration, Nordic Plate for increased armor, and Royal Amulet and O.L.U.M. to boost damage output can make her so powerful that movement becomes unnecessary. She can stand her ground in the thick of enemies without much risk, and no one shall pass.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/fbdaec40bd32d204aeec014ff022afac39a8b287.gif

The Occult Rune is a unique Trinket—it boosts the experience gained from defeating enemies but sacrifices an upgrade in the process. It's an excellent early-game choice when enemies are less threatening, but as the game progresses, it becomes riskier. However, this drawback doesn’t apply when playing as the King. For him, picking up the Occult Rune is always a good option, as it allows him to enchant his sword into the powerful Spectral Blade.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/e2a7350394c8b36d0af4e1b5146396893117cbef.gif

Additionally, there are Trinkets that are universally good on any hero. O.L.U.M. increases the attack area, Royal Amulet boosts attack damage, and Ahriman Wing raises the critical hit chance of all weapons, making them reliable choices for any build.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/fdf978cc33964ad98f25c319c5b6f4274c3fa255.png


 You can have a maximum of 6 Trinkets at a time, so plan ahead
 Trinkets can be upgraded to a max level of 4 during a game
 Not every Trinket is available from the beginning, some take certain conditions to unlock
 Check the Quests Menu for unlock conditions
 Level 4 Trinkets are needed to unleash any Weapon Enchantment
 Rune Trinkets have a powerful effect, but they also come with a downside
 Try compensating these side effects with other Trinkets


You can still enjoy the demo while it lasts, and get to know your favorite combo in depths!
Happy gaming,
Kane, Community Manager

notes.title: Warrior Breakdown - The King
notes.content:
The King - Fearless Protagonist
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/63bdd688ea40c3f0ba3c291b40f795d53dee54fc.png
The King surely hasn’t led an easy life. 
When he was still a kid, his evil relatives cooked up a diabolical scheme trying to pry away the Kingdom that was rightfully his. His teen years were dominated by defending his throne from greedy intruders, constantly attacking him and his people. While this tumultuous past often weighed heavy on the King, it has also made him more resilient and the perfect allrounder on the battlefield. Equipped with his trusty Royal Sword, the matured King’s combat skills are about to be put to the ultimate test:

Now, in the face of impending doom, with evil forces emerging all over the planet, threatening its inhabitants everywhere, the King assembles the strongest Warriors from all the Realms, as the stakes are higher than ever before: 
This time it is not only his Kingdom he has to protect, but the entire world.
[hr][/hr]Ability: Dash
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/6723272cedb77a95adca3eddaf46dbef88eb0610.png
A life of fighting has taught the King the art of war. He knows, even the toughest Warrior can be struck down by a single blow. The importance of a nimble defense tactic can’t be understated since his Ability to evade enemy attacks by dashing, has saved his life many times.

 The King dashes in the direction he's facing, evading enemies.
 Leveling up adds more charges and grants brief invulnerability.
https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaHZlZ2FuMG8yeWFhZTVocTZyOG5uYWFtd3NwY3I0N2txZnVnNzZheSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/6RTn1T7gPsaaYPg3x5/giphy-downsized-large.gif
[hr][/hr]Starter Weapon: Royal Sword {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/7d040181e3c8bb0a22fcd487cf17ab5f5380e368.png
Every King needs a sword. Gifted to him as a little child, the Royal Sword has served our King in countless battles, always being his no. 1 trusty companion.
 Attacks in a 180° cone in front of the King.
 Attacks can be manually aimed.
 Leveling up the Royal Sword increases:

 Damage
 Attack Area
 Attack Speedhttps://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMTYwejc2anZrOXZzMGtqOGRvNm9wM2F2NzRmanpnNjMyMDBwZmg2NiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/ujX98dK7zrWT11bvCM/giphy.gif
[hr][/hr]Sword Weapon Enchantments
Since the King starts off each battle with his Royal Sword already equipped, Weapon Enchantments aiming at his blade are always a good choice. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/1106bdf53d8e0bfe053ff3d289fda2d05d40dc9b.png
Lightning Blade: Unleashes a lightning attack that chains between multiple enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/ba26ceee60e72155ab031d147b8938d84a5c7a9f.png
Spectral Blade: Summons flying swords that target enemies across the screen.

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOWtuY3dxcGxhbmpuMTEyNnhsdTI3NmJmcHVvdXhjbHZiNjZsNTkwdiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/0lmfbNdnR6lPutGgNP/giphy-downsized-large.gif
[hr][/hr]Recommended Weapon Choices
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/c733904e9102f4b4adb0e1898cb8ec8a196e766a.png
Viking Hammer: Adds crowd control with stunning effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/a08b25a636e6969741b0cabcdcfb02eb880a00d3.png
Whirling Axe: Covers the King's blind spot with stationary whirling axes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/5266168a02c35edc43fe3f0807819e2c60562b3e.png
Monk's Brew: Attacks in all directions, making it great for controlling mobs.

How to use the Weapons in Combat
For additional damage and utility, picking the Viking Hammer provides crowd control by stunning enemies and dealing extra damage. Consider the Wave Quake Hammer enchantment to create shockwaves that damage enemies while you Dash, making it easier to navigate crowded battlefields in the late game.

Combining the Royal Sword with Monk's Brew allows for effective crowd control, making it easier to take down Goblins and swarms while staying safe.

Alternatively, the Whirling Axe is a solid option to eliminate the King's blind spot by placing Whirling Axes behind him. When enchanted with the Vortex Axe, it draws in enemies and deals heavy damage, giving the King breathing room in battle.

[hr][/hr]Recommended Trinkets

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/2d7d16bb47eb1dd4ea591ac11f3d4068e462a2b7.png
Shadow Boots: Enhance mobility and synergy with Dash.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/ab9cb81c72f4c9b99826f2e1c81c25f6ae3012b1.png
O.L.U.M.: Increases Attack Area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/978947a22b891bd7d3a7f81b2c7a196fadb36529.png
Dragon Fangs: Boosts weapon attack frequency.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/1bfa2eec17e281b1393c2679c08f94637f074b3d.png
Secret Tincture: Increases the number of Royal Sword, Viking Hammer, and Whirling Axe strikes.

Why choose these Trinkets
Dash becomes a powerful tool when paired with Shadow Boots, letting you easily weave in and out of combat while maximizing the impact of each Sword strike.

As enemies grow tougher, use Trinkets like O.L.U.M. to enhance your weapon range, Dragon Fangs to increase Attack Speed, and Secret Tincture to amplify your Royal Sword, Viking Hammer and Whirling Axe strikes.

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNGVlanAzcjVuOHJqNWx1NjFhMGE3ajZ5eW12bTN0ZXl4ZjNxdHpiZSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/jksOnO1TR2eI9smxe5/giphy-downsized-large.gif

[hr][/hr]Coop Strategy
The King excels in co-op play, especially when teamed with ranged characters like Cultist or Umberto. His durability makes him an excellent protector, helping to shield more vulnerable allies during the early game. This allows your ranged teammates to focus on dealing damage while you keep enemies at bay, creating a strong synergy that supports the entire team.

https://i.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZTM2ZndzdHQxNGpibHNjbWFzZnNqMWRvcThwcHVqdmZyanYwZTR4OSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/5TEdVOTXk44geNURtt/giphy-downsized-large.gif
[hr][/hr]Cheat Sheet
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/2450cebbd7968cfe5b3ec49fa7e084393965095c.jpg
[hr][/hr]Royal Re:Vault
The King’s original designs were created over 13 years ago. Being the face of his franchise, it has undergone many changes over the course of the 4 games he has now starred in.
Leading up to “Royal Revolt Warriors” we watched him grow from a little kid, to a teenager and lastly to a grown man.

While concepting the “aged” version of the King (first seen in“Royal Revolt: A Trader’s Tale”), we had to find the right balance between having him visibly mature since the events of Royal Revolt 2, while still maintaining the instant recognizability of the beloved design.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/0d0d2f353edbd4382ad1c8de04c8b8f8307d111c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/bec7b9c6386ceaff6491efe1b8df920cd355b6da.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117162/19dd2a663183ef5364bf9af3331c6131724e68c3.jpg

Want to learn more? Join us on Discord!

notes.title: The Second Royal Revolt Warriors Demo is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings Warriors!

The wait is over! Our second major demo for Royal Revolt Warriors has just been released, and it’s packed with fresh content and new challenges. 

Here’s a sneak peek at the latest additions to the game that we’d love for you to explore:

 New Warrior Abilities: Some characters now come with unique abilities, such as Dashing and special attacks.
 Two New Maps: Discover brand new battlegrounds, with challenging end bosses.
 Weapon Enchantments: Combine Weapons and Trinkets to create powerful Enchantments.
 New Warriors: The Cultist and Umberto now join the roster, fighting alongside our other Warriors.
 New Trinkets: Powerful Runes that offer both advantages and disadvantages.
 Hard Mode: By popular demand, we’ve added a hard mode for those seeking a tougher challenge.
 More language support for: Italian, French and Spanish
 Improved gameplay: Improved balancing to make the game play even more fun.
 Improved UI/UX: Few changes on the UI and UX based on the user feedback.

We can’t wait to hear what you think! Your feedback has been incredible so far, and it's shaping the future of Royal Revolt Warriors. Jump into the new demo, and let us know what you love (or what you want more of)!

Let the battle continue! 💥

notes.title: Development Update
notes.content:
Greetings Warriors!

It’s been a little while since we got back from Gamescom, and we’ve been hard at work ever since! First off, we want to say how much we appreciated meeting so many of you in person and watching you dive into Royal Revolt Warriors with such enthusiasm.

Your energy and feedback really gave us a boost. But it wasn’t just at Gamescom, we are thrilled to see all the feedback coming in here on Steam and across our other channels. Whether it was suggestions, comments, or just sharing your excitement for the game, we’ve taken it all in.

As soon as we got back, we jumped straight into development, focusing on turning your feedback into improvements, as well as working on some exciting new ideas we've had. There's a lot going on behind the scenes and we're really looking forward to showing you some of these changes in the next demo update. 

We’re super excited about what’s coming next, and while we don’t have a specific date to share just yet, we’ll have more information on the update very soon. In the meantime, keep the feedback coming, it’s helping us shape the game in a big way!

Your Royal Revolt Warriors Team

notes.title: Demo is out now!
notes.content:
Greetings Warriors!

We’re excited to welcome you to an exclusive preview of Royal Revolt Warriors! The first demo is now live, and we can't wait for you to dive into the action-packed world we've crafted for you. 

Download the demo

Here's a taste of what you can experience:

Command Unique Warriors
Unlock and lead 5 unique Warriors, each bringing their own strengths and stories to the battlefield. 

Battle Through the Royal Forest
Step into the Royal Forest, a once peaceful place now twisted by dark forces. As you journey through this ominous environment, you’ll uncover secrets that may reveal the origins of this creeping evil.

Wield a Variety of Weapons
With 9 distinct weapons at your disposal, you can customize your combat style to suit your strategy. From swift sword strikes to powerful magical attacks, there’s a weapon for every type of Warrior. Adapt your arsenal to face the varied challenges that lie ahead.

Team Up in Couch Co-Op
Share the adventure with a friend in two-player couch co-op mode. Coordinating with a partner makes for even more exciting and dynamic gameplay as you tackle enemies and overcome obstacles together.

Level Up with Meta-Upgrades
Boost your Warriors' abilities with meta-upgrades, giving you the edge in battle. As the challenges intensify, your strategic choices will be key to turning the tide in your favor.

Your Feedback Matters
We're eager to hear what you think of the Royal Revolt Warriors demo! Your feedback is invaluable as we continue to refine the game. Help us make this the best experience it can be.
